git-init.title: Ek khali room chuno
git-init.body: Git ko kisi bhi folder par point karo — jisme abhi kuch bhi na ho.

git-init.title: .git folder dikhta hai
git-init.body: Git poora repository ek chhupe .git directory me banata hai: objects/ (khali), refs/ (khali), HEAD, aur index.

git-init.title: Abhi kuch track nahi hota
git-init.body: Na koi objects, na koi commits. Git sirf ready hai — aapke pehle git add aur git commit ka intezaar kar raha hai.

git-status.title: Dekho
git-status.body: Jaanna hai ki kya badla. Bas git status chalao — ye teen snapshots compare karta hai: aapki files, index, aur last commit.

git-status.title: Columns padho
git-status.body: Har file ko ek state marker milta hai. ✚ staged = commit ke liye ready. ✏ modified = disk par badla hua. Blue = bilkul nayi, kabhi track nahi hui.

git-status.title: Comparison ka trick
git-status.body: Status poori files nahi padhta — index ki fast hash ko disk file ki hash se compare karta hai. Hash same? File unchanged.

git-add.title: File change karo
git-add.body: Aap src/button.tsx edit karte ho. Git dekhta hai ki worktree ab index se match nahi karti — file 'modified' hai lekin staged nahi.

git-add.title: git add chalao
git-add.body: File ka content blob object me hash hota hai, aur index path → blob-hash store karta hai. Aapki file ab 'next commit' preview ka hissa hai.

git-add.title: Disk par kuch move nahi hua
git-add.body: Working file bilkul waisi hi rehti hai. Staging sirf index likhta hai — ek note jo kehta hai 'ye content agla snapshot hai'.

git-commit.title: Pehle stage karo
git-commit.body: Commit se pehle files index (staging) me hoti hain. Index commit ka preview hai.

git-commit.title: git commit chalao
git-commit.body: Git index ko tree object me wrap karta hai, phir commit object banata hai jo us tree aur previous commit (uska parent) ko point karta hai.

git-commit.title: Commit ko aate dekho
git-commit.body: Ek naya commit object graph me judta hai. Branch pointer aage slide karti hai aur HEAD follow karta hai. History ek node lambi ho gayi.

git-config.title: Apna naam set karo
git-config.body: Pehle commit se pehle Git ko identity chahiye — naam aur email jo aapke har commit me likha jaata hai.

git-config.title: Apni email set karo
git-config.body: Commits is identity ke saath author aur committer lines ke roop me stamp hote hain — commit object me hamesha ke liye baked.

git-config.title: Saare aliases dekho
git-config.body: Config ek cascade hai: ye repo → aapka user (~/.gitconfig) → machine. Jo sabse paas hai wohi jeet-ta hai.

git-branch.title: Apna starting point chuno
git-branch.body: Branch sirf commit ka pointer hai. HEAD jahan bhi ho, wahan naya naam hang kar sakte ho.

git-branch.title: git branch chalao
git-branch.body: Ek chhoti ref file current commit ke hash ke saath likhi jaati hai. Ab do naam ek hi commit ko point karte hain.

git-branch.title: Aap ab bhi main par ho
git-branch.body: Branch sirf pointer banata hai — aapko move nahi karta. Wo kaam git switch ka hai.

git-checkout.title: Kahan khade hona hai?
git-checkout.body: Checkout HEAD ko ek branch se doosri par flip karta hai — aur working files ko us branch se match karne ke liye rewrite karta hai.

git-checkout.title: HEAD move hota hai, files follow karti hain
git-checkout.body: HEAD file ab kehti hai ref: refs/heads/feature. Feature ke commit ke blobs disk par copy hote hain taaki aapka worktree match kare.

git-checkout.title: Safety pehle
git-checkout.body: Agar file me unsaved edits hain, checkout unhe destroy karne ke bajaye mana kar deta hai. -f matlab 'main sach me karna chahta hoon'.

git-switch.title: Focused checkout
git-switch.body: SWITCH checkout ka sirf branch-wala hissa hai. Ek kaam: HEAD ko branches ke beech move karna.

git-switch.title: Poora hop ek pointer edit hai
git-switch.body: HEAD.txt doosri branch ke naam se rewritten hota hai. Disk par files us branch ke blobs se synchronized hoti hain.

git-switch.title: Create + hop ek saath
git-switch.body: git switch -c name branch plus switch do kaam ek me karta hai — checkout -b ka modern replacement.

git-merge.title: Do branches, do timelines
git-merge.body: Aapki feature branch aur main dono move hui hain jab se same commit se split hui thi.

git-merge.title: Three-way merge
git-merge.body: Git base commit ko dono tips se compare karta hai, phir dono sets of changes ko combine karta hai. Alag regions khud merge ho jaate hain.

git-merge.title: Conflict ka waqt
git-merge.body: Dono sides ne same lines edit ki? Git guess nahi karta — dono ko <<<<<<< aur >>>>>>> markers ke saath dikhata hai.

git-rebase.title: Naya base, wahi ideas
git-rebase.body: Aap chahte ho ki aapki feature newest main par baithe — kisi stale fork point par nahi.

git-rebase.title: Replay karo, copy nahi
git-rebase.body: Har feature commit main ke naye tip par re-create hota hai. Same diff, naya parent, naya hash. Wahi changes, cleaner story.

git-rebase.title: Conflicts ek-ek commit par handle karo
git-rebase.body: Agar replayed commit takra jaaye, rebase ruk jaata hai taaki aap fix karo, phir continue. Commit by commit.

git-rebase.title: Rewrite rule
git-rebase.body: Rebased commits ko naye hashes milte hain. Jo doosron ne pull kar liya use kabhi rebase mat karo — aise force-pushes paida hote hain.

git-log.title: Puchho kisne kya kiya
git-log.body: git log HEAD se shuru hota hai aur har parent pointer follow karta hai, har commit print karta hai.

git-log.title: Ye linked list hai
git-log.body: Trick: commits sirf apne parents ko jaante hain. Log bas us chain par chal raha hai — neeche, neeche, first commit tak.

git-show.title: Ek commit kholo
git-show.body: git show ek single object ka full anatomy dikhata hai — commit ke liye, metadata plus uska diff.

git-show.title: Past se file nikalo
git-show.body: rev:path syntax kisi bhi file ko bilkul waisa print karta hai jaise wo thi: git show HEAD~2:src/App.tsx.

git-diff.title: Maine kya touch kiya?
git-diff.body: git diff aapki working files ko index se compare karta hai — har edit jo aapne abhi stage nahi kiya.

git-diff.title: Dekho kya staged hai
git-diff.body: git diff --cached index ko HEAD se compare karta hai — aapke next commit ka preview.

git-diff.title: Blob hashing kaam chhota karta hai
git-diff.body: Same content = same SHA-1 — matching blobs instantly skip hote hain. Sirf changed files diff engine me jaati hain.

git-blame.title: Culprit dhundo (polite ho kar)
git-blame.body: git blame file ki history backward walk karta hai aur har line us commit se mark karta hai jisne usse introduce kiya.

git-blame.title: Trail follow karo
git-blame.body: Blamed commit se git show ke saath uske message par jump karo — 'kyun' aksar waheen likha hota hai.

git-reflog.title: Undo stack
git-reflog.body: Jab bhi HEAD move hota hai — commit, reset, rebase, checkout, amend — git usse journal karta hai. git reflog wahi journal print karta hai.

git-reflog.title: Kuch bhi recover karo
git-reflog.body: Hard-reset bahut door gaya? Reflog me purani position dhundo aur HEAD ko wapas point karo. Commit ab bhi objects/ me hai.

git-reflog.title: 90-din ki window
git-reflog.body: Unreachable commits delete nahi hote — bas wait karte hain. git gc unhe default 90 din ke baad finally prune karta hai.

git-gc.title: Repository mota ho jaata hai
git-gc.body: Har add aur commit alag-alag compressed loose files likhta hai. Haazaron ke baad .git bloated aur slow ho jaata hai.

git-gc.title: Compress aur prune
git-gc.body: git gc loose objects ko ek delta-compressed packfile me pack karta hai aur unreachable, aged-out objects delete karta hai.

git-reset.title: Bahut door, bahut fast
git-reset.body: Ek ganda commit aapki branch ke tip par hai. Aap chahte ho branch pointer uspar se peeche slide kare.

git-reset.title: Pointer rewind karta hai
git-reset.body: Branch file purane commit ko point karne ke liye rewritten hoti hai. Oops commit ab bhi objects/ me hai — bas unreachable.

git-reset.title: Regret ki teen gehrayi
git-reset.body: soft cheezein staged rakhta hai, mixed (default) unstage karta hai, hard aapki files ko bhi revert kar deta hai.

git-restore.title: File kharab kar di?
git-restore.body: Aapki src/bug.js ki working copy tooti hui hai. Restore use index (ya HEAD) se rewrite karta hai.

git-restore.title: Galti se unstage ho gaya?
git-restore.body: restore --staged HEAD ka version wapas index me kheenchta hai, file ko unstage karke — disk ko touch kiye bina.

git-restore.title: History se wapas lao
git-restore.body: --source kisi bhi revision ka blob nikala deta hai. Gayi file, purana version, jo bhi — read karke nikaal lo.

git-revert.title: Shared branch, toota commit
git-revert.body: Ek ganda commit har teammate tak ja chuka. Reset se rewrite karne par unke clones toot jaate — isliye hum add karte hain.

git-revert.title: Correction, erasure nahi
git-revert.body: git revert reverse diff ko ek brand-new commit ke roop me top par apply karta hai. Ganda commit history me rehta hai — sach me.

git-stash.title: Feature beech me ruk gaya
git-stash.body: Aadha-finished changes aapke worktree me hain, lekin abhi branch switch karni hai.

git-stash.title: Ek box me park kiya
git-stash.body: Aapke changes stash stack par special commits ke roop me record hote hain, aur worktree clean HEAD par reset hota hai.

git-stash.title: Baad me wapas aana
git-stash.body: Koi branch, kabhi bhi: git stash pop stack ka top reapply karta hai aur use remove kar deta hai.

git-cherry-pick.title: Ek fix, doosri branch me bhi
git-cherry-pick.body: Ek hotfix main par aa gaya, lekin release branch ko abhi chahiye — main ka poora merge kiye bina.

git-cherry-pick.title: Release par replay
git-cherry-pick.body: Release par ek naya commit aata hai — same change, lekin brand-new hash aur parent ke saath.

git-clean.title: Idhar-udhar files
git-clean.body: Untracked files aur build ka kachra worktree me pada hai. Pehle preview karo ki clean kya hatayega.

git-clean.title: Full sweep
git-clean.body: clean -fd untracked files AUR directories delete karta hai; -x ignored files bhi remove karta hai. Permanent — isliye pehle preview.

git-clone.title: Pura project pakad lo
git-clone.body: Aap ek remote URL par point karte ho. Sab kuch — har commit, branch, tag — neeche flow hone wala hai.

git-clone.title: Fetch + checkout ek me
git-clone.body: Clone literally ek fetch (saare objects download) hai uske baad ek checkout (default branch materialize karna).

git-clone.title: Origin aapke liye wired hai
git-clone.body: refs/remotes/origin/main ban jaati hai aur aapki main use track karna seekh jaati hai — isi se day one par git pull kaam karta hai.

git-remote.title: Doosri repo bookmark karo
git-remote.body: Remote sirf name → URL ka note hai. Fetch ya push tak koi network nahi hota.

git-remote.title: Fork workflow
git-remote.body: origin aapka hai, upstream original. Dono bookmarks rakho aur kahin se bhi sync kar sakte ho.

git-fetch.title: Badle bina dekho
git-fetch.body: Aap remote ke naye commits par peek karna chahte ho bina apne kaam ko disturb kiye.

git-fetch.title: Remote refs update hoti hain, aap nahi
git-fetch.body: refs/remotes/origin/main aage slide hoti hai. Aapki apni main, index aur worktree untouched rehte hain.

git-fetch.title: Future preview karo
git-fetch.body: git diff HEAD..origin/main dikhata hai ki ek pull kya laayega — usse commit karne se pehle.

git-pull.title: Team ke saath sync
git-pull.body: git pull remote ka naya kaam fetch karta hai, phir use aapki current branch me merge karta hai.

git-pull.title: …phir merge fold karta hai
git-pull.body: Agar aapne koi local commit nahi kiya, main bas fast-forward hoti hai. Kiya hai to merge commit (ya rebase) unhe jodta hai.

git-pull.title: Merge ki jagah rebase
git-pull.body: git pull --rebase aapke local edits ko merge ki jagah top par replay karta hai — ek clean, seedhi line.

git-push.title: Apne commits share karo
git-push.body: Aapne locally commit kiya. Remote ke paas wo objects abhi nahi hain — wo upar travel karne wale hain.

git-push.title: Upload + advance
git-push.body: Aapke naye objects remote par stream hote hain, aur origin/main aapki branch se match karne ke liye advance hota hai.

git-push.title: Rejected? Aap peeche ho
git-push.body: Remote history khona mana karta hai. Pehle pull --rebase, phir push — shared branches ki daily rhythm.

git-push.title: Force-push, safely
git-push.body: Remote branch rewrite karni hai? Sirf --force-with-lease: ye tabhi force karta hai jab remote waisa hi ho jaisa aapne aakhri baar dekha.

git-tag.title: Milestone freeze karo
git-tag.body: Aapne v1.0.0 ship kiya. Branch drift karti hai — aapko ek aisa naam chahiye jo kabhi move na ho.

git-tag.title: Pin drop hota hai
git-tag.body: Ek tag ref us commit ko hamesha ke liye point karta hai — chahe main aage race kare, v1.0.0 wahi point karta rehta hai.
